title: 36 Hours in Nantucket, Mass.
abstract: Glorious public beaches, untouched moors and dunes, and sophisticated dining and shopping on this island off Cape Cod.

title: 36 Hours in Minneapolis
abstract: Urban edginess, cultural authenticity, not to mention spiced meatballs in lingonberry sauce: the perfect formula for a weekend away.

title: 36 Hours in Boulder, Colo.
abstract: Who even needs the legal marijuana? Boulder is an exceptionally easygoing place to hang out.

title: 36 Hours in Belgrade
abstract: Epic night life, thriving cafe culture, hearty meals and emerging, design-conscious industrial districts: Belgrade has a gritty, distinctive appeal.
